title: Gather Fellowship

scene_beats.setting: Ravenswood hall at dusk. One candle. Ink-black rafters, paper-white map on a long table.
scene_beats.action: Lord Ravenswood rolls out a map with three villages circled in ash.

scene_beats.setting: Oakwood gate, forest edge. Tall gray gate, one torch, moths circling it like a slow galaxy.
scene_beats.action: Bryn stands guard, sword drawn, eyes locked on a single moth.

dialogue.speaker: Bryn
text_lines: Do not move. It knows we

dialogue.speaker: Bryn
text_lines: That is what it WANTS you

scene_beats.setting: Quillan's village kitchen. Steam, copper pots, a scorched star chart pinned over the stove.
scene_beats.action: Quillan stirs a pot that hums. He offers a spoon to everyone.

zeref_moment: Zeref eats the scary moth, then purrs at Bryn proudly.

title: Whispers in Woods

scene_beats.setting: Forest edge at night. Black trunks drawn in shaky ink, one path of pale moss, a tiny campfire.
scene_beats.action: The Tattered Traveler warms his hands and speaks without looking up.

dialogue.speaker: Tattered Traveler
text_lines: There is a city in these

dialogue.speaker: Tattered Traveler
text_lines: Or it is a really big

scene_beats.setting: Same campfire, other travelers. Faces are blank paper ovals, mouths just a thin line.
scene_beats.action: Whispers overlap. Text appears as faint gray.

dialogue.speaker: Tattered Traveler
text_lines: will want to still be here

scene_beats.setting: Path entrance. Two wisps hover between trees, the only blue in a black frame.
scene_beats.action: Arin fills the lantern. Mote tries to eat a wisp and sneezes stars.

zeref_moment: Zeref's eye stars swirl at the trees. He goes in first.

title: Forest Guardian

scene_beats.setting: Wisps form a trail of blue dots through black forest. Roots look like sleeping hands.
scene_beats.action: Follow the wisps. If you stray, they wait and blink impatiently.

scene_beats.setting: Clearing with a stone figure taller than the trees. Moss beard, two lantern eyes.
scene_beats.action: The Forest Guardian wakes. Dust and leaves fall from its shoulders.

scene_beats.setting: Grove after tests. Dawn-gray light leaks through branches. Calaminth flowers glow faintly.
scene_beats.action: The Guardian hands Arin a sprig of Calaminth and points at the cave.

dialogue.speaker: Forest Guardian
text_lines: Your test is below. In the

rooms.description: Bent trail of moss stones; wisps hop ahead.

attack_animation.description: Cloud tightens into a ball, then bursts outward in 3 frames.

rooms.puzzle: Step only on stones a wisp just lit; others sink into ink.

rooms.description: Hollow log tunnel, roots twitch as you pass.

attack_animation.description: Root coils (1), lashes (2), retracts with a dirt puff (3).

rooms.puzzle: Mote's glow scares roots back; keep Mote near to pass.

rooms.description: Ring of mushrooms; wisps dance in a pattern.
rooms.puzzle: Repeat the wisp dance: 4-step direction pattern.

boss.name: The Forest Guardian (Test of Courage)
boss.mechanic: Charges in straight lines; stand your ground on the glowing ring and it veers.

idle_animation.description: Antlers of black branches sway; breath puffs blue.

phases.transformation: Ancient guardian of ink branches, antlered, wisps in its crown.

attacks.name: Antler Charge
attacks.telegraph: Lowers head, hoof scrapes 2x, dust puff

animation.description: Head down, scrape, lunge, skid stop

phases.transformation: Antlers grow twice as wide, wisps caught in them glow like eyes.

attacks.name: Wisp Snare
attacks.effect: Wisps fire at your last spot

animation.description: Antler glow, wisps detach, streak, pop

attacks.name: Double Charge
attacks.telegraph: Two hoof scrapes and a snort ring

defeat_animation.description: Kneels, antlers drop leaves, bows, steps aside for the next test.

boss.canon: bible 2.3 (ancient guardian, three tests); test encounter, Attunable, not a bible numbered boss
boss.sprite_note: Reuses Cosmo's Hollow Stag frames (bible gives the guardian no look, so the antlered ink-branch body can stay).

zeref_moment: Zeref sits on the Guardian's foot. It lets him stay.

title: Grumbleback

scene_beats.setting: Cave mouth: crystal teeth around a black throat. Faint purple light deep inside.
scene_beats.action: Arin enters alone, except for the beasts, who refuse to be left.

scene_beats.setting: Deep chamber. A crystal on a stone stump, glowing. Huge mossy shape breathing in the dark.
scene_beats.action: Grumbleback lunges. Fight or Block and Hum. The game nudges Hum.

scene_beats.setting: Same chamber, crystal light flooding. Ghostly ink hands painted over every wall.
scene_beats.action: Arin touches the crystal: visions of the First Hands. Grumbleback blocks the exit.

dialogue.speaker: Arin
text_lines: I saw them. The ones who

rooms.description: Crystal stalactites drip light; floor tiles crack.
rooms.puzzle: Trap floor: cracked tiles fall after 1 sec. Follow the dry tiles.

rooms.description: Narrow gallery of beast nests and bones.

attack_animation.description: Curls up (1), rolls (2), bounces off wall (3), unrolls (4).

rooms.puzzle: Push glow crystals into sockets to light the gallery.

rooms.description: Echo pool. Your reflection moves late.
rooms.puzzle: Hum at the pool: the echo opens a hidden crawlspace.

rooms.description: Grumbleback's den: moss bed, a pile of stolen socks.
rooms.puzzle: Boss room.

boss.name: Grumbleback, the Cave Beast
boss.mechanic: Attack it and Agitation rises; Block and Hum to drop Agitation. Attune at 0 to win kindly.

idle_animation.description: Huge mossy back rises and falls; one eye peeks from moss.

phases.transformation: Half hidden in dark, only eye and claws visible.

animation.description: Eye flash, crouch, leap, land with dust

phases.transformation: Stands fully: twice as tall, crystals sprout on its back.

attacks.name: Crystal Quake
attacks.telegraph: Rears up on hind legs, crystals glow

animation.description: Rear, hang, slam, ripple, stalactites fall

phases.transformation: Back crystals blaze, moss lifts like a mane. Scared, not angry.

attacks.name: Panic Roll
attacks.telegraph: Curls into a ball, crystals spin

animation.description: Curl, spin, bounce, bounce, bounce, dizzy

attacks.name: Sad Howl
attacks.telegraph: Looks at its socks, eyes wet
attacks.effect: Slows party; Hum here Attunes instantly

animation.description: Look down, sniff, howl up, sniffle

defeat_animation.description: Flops on its back, rolls over, nuzzles Arin, tiny butterfly lands on nose, it sneezes.

zeref_moment: Zeref climbs Grumbleback and sits on his head like a crown.

title: The Others' Trials
location: Three Trial Pages: Moth Page, Giant's Table, Temple Room

scene_beats.setting: Moth Glade: thousands of white moths on black bark, all wings opening at once.
scene_beats.action: Play as Bryn. Hold your ground; moths swarm the lantern.

dialogue.speaker: Bryn
text_lines: I am not scared. I am not

scene_beats.setting: A giant's table under a hill. Bowl the size of a lake. The giant is round and sad-eyed.
scene_beats.action: Play as Quillan. The giant wants soup. Riddle: what does it really want?

scene_beats.setting: Ruined temple room, one candle, Edric's long shadow on the wall.
scene_beats.action: Play as Edric. Admit the truth to the party.

dialogue.speaker: Edric
text_lines: scared. I hid. I let you

rooms.description: White moths sleep on every trunk.
rooms.puzzle: Lower lantern to sneak; raise it to scatter. Wrong time wakes all.

rooms.description: Spiral of trees closing tighter.
rooms.puzzle: Walk the spiral without letting the lantern die.

boss.name: The Moth Swarm (Bryn's Trial of Courage)
boss.mechanic: Pulls light from lanterns. Stand still and brave to refill.

idle_animation.description: A cloud of white moths circles the lantern, wing-dust glittering.

phases.transformation: A swarm as tall as Bryn, wings like torn paper.
The swarm doubles, curls around Bryn; wing spots look like eyes.

attacks.name: Swarm Surge
attacks.telegraph: The cloud brightens in the middle

animation.description: Glow, shiver, moths pour, flap, scatter

defeat_animation.description: Swarm thins to a few moths; one lands on Bryn's shoulder. She does not scream.

boss.canon: bible 2.6: 'Bryn faces a swarm of moths'; trial encounter, not a bible boss

zeref_moment: Zeref sits in the giant's bowl and gets soup on his beanie.

title: Citadel in Mist
location: Cliffs, Citadel in the Mist, the Murals

scene_beats.setting: Cliff path over white mist. Thin rope bridges. Wind lines drawn like scratches.
scene_beats.action: Climb and cross. Climber Boots unlock on the first ledge.

scene_beats.setting: Ruined citadel: vines on crumbling statues, walls carved with murals pulsing faint blue.
scene_beats.action: The Sacred Crystal glows. Symbols answer it one by one.

scene_beats.setting: Giant doors, ten times Arin's height. Blue light pouring through the crack.
scene_beats.action: The doors grind open. Grumbleback sits down in the doorway.

rooms.description: Rope bridge in fog, planks missing.
rooms.puzzle: Wind gusts every 3 sec; cross between them.

rooms.description: Sheer wall with handholds glowing faintly.
rooms.puzzle: Climb only holds that pulse with the crystal.

rooms.description: Mural corridor before the gate.

attack_animation.description: Eyes light (1), stone arm lifts (2), slam (3), dust (4).

rooms.puzzle: Hold the crystal to each mural in order of the Seven Dark Days.

boss.name: The Guardian Statues (Citadel Gate)
boss.mechanic: Statues of the First Hands wake at the doors. Hit each chest rune only while the crystal makes it glow.

idle_animation.description: Stone chest rune pulses slowly; mist pours off shoulders.

phases.transformation: One statue wakes waist-deep in mist.
Two more statues rise beside it; vines snap off.

attacks.name: Mist Breath
attacks.telegraph: Cheeks of stone crack and glow

phases.transformation: The three crack; blue light leaks from every seam.

animation.description: Pieces lift, spin, hover, fall, fall, regroup

defeat_animation.description: Statues kneel and crumble; runes float to the doors and the doors open.

boss.canon: bible 7.3 Ruined Citadels hazard 'guardian statues' + 2.7 crystal opens doors; gate encounter, not a bible boss

zeref_moment: Zeref looks down the cliff, then leans out for more.

title: The Sentinel

scene_beats.setting: Citadel atrium: pillars lost in black. A cold wind visibly sweeps across the frame.
scene_beats.action: Every lantern goes out. Only Mote and Zeref glow.

scene_beats.setting: A hooded dark figure on a stair. Only the glow from the beasts outlines her.
scene_beats.action: Choose Reason or Fight. Fight is short; she just waits.

scene_beats.setting: Hood falls back: woman with snow-white wings, piercing eyes. Lanterns relight blue.
scene_beats.action: Hesper descends. A butterfly lands on her wing; she fails to stay serious.

dialogue.speaker: Sentinel Hesper
text_lines: I am Hesper. I will guide

rooms.description: Pitch black hall; only glow radius visible.
rooms.puzzle: Keep the beasts close; glow radius is the map.

rooms.description: Stair of forgotten candles.
rooms.puzzle: Relight candles with Mote's sneeze to reveal the stairs.

boss.name: Sentinel Hesper (Reason or Fight)
boss.mechanic: She never truly attacks; she only waits. Choosing Reason ends it. Fighting just tires you.

idle_animation.description: Hooded, still; wings shift under the cloak; breath fogs.

phases.transformation: Cloak tears; white wings spread full screen width.

attacks.name: Feather Wall
attacks.effect: Ring of feathers stops you, no damage

animation.description: Spread, glint, feathers fly, ring, fade

attacks.name: Patient Stare
attacks.effect: Nothing. She waits for you to stop.

defeat_animation.description: Hood falls, she smiles, butterfly lands, she sneezes softly.

zeref_moment: In the dark, Zeref's eyes are the last stars. He blinks.

title: Hall of Whispers

scene_beats.setting: Long hall of black glass. Whispers float as faint text along the walls.
scene_beats.action: Walk the hall. Whispers say things nobody in the party said.

scene_beats.setting: A huge mirror, silver frame of hands. It shows strangers, then the party alone.
scene_beats.action: Boss: The Mirror That Isn't Yours. Walk toward companions' reflections.

scene_beats.setting: Mirror cracked, hall quiet. An old lantern on the floor where the mirror stood.
scene_beats.action: Edric picks up his family lantern, thought lost.

rooms.description: Glass corridor; whispers slow you.
rooms.puzzle: Walk only when whispers stop; moving during a whisper pulls you back.

rooms.description: Room of small mirrors, each a different face.

attack_animation.description: Copies your pose (1), cracks (2), shard throw (3).

rooms.puzzle: Break only mirrors that show nobody you know.

boss.name: The Mirror That Isn't Yours
boss.mechanic: Not a fight. Each phase, walk to a companion's reflection, dodging fear images.

idle_animation.description: Surface ripples like water; strangers' faces drift.

phases.transformation: Mirror the size of a door.
Mirror grows to fill the wall; frame hands reach out.
Mirror wraps the whole room; you stand inside it.

attacks.name: Lonely
attacks.telegraph: Screen goes silent, all reflections leave
attacks.effect: Walls close in until you say the line

animation.description: Reflections walk away, dark, close, close, close, crack

defeat_animation.description: Cracks from center, light leaks, shatters into floating silver dust.

zeref_moment: Zeref sees no reflection of himself and rawrs at the mirror.

title: Doubt Made Flesh
location: Chamber of Illumination and Arena of Souls

scene_beats.setting: Chamber of tomes bound in liquid silver, each pulsing like a heartbeat.
scene_beats.action: Riddle. Answer Light, a flame, or warmth.

dialogue.speaker: Tome
text_lines: The more of me you give
away, the more of me there

scene_beats.setting: Round arena, stone seats full of faceless shadows. One figure rises in the center.
scene_beats.action: Doubt Made Flesh wears Arin's own failures: abandoned pages, smudges.

scene_beats.setting: Arena flooded with gold light. Mist where Doubt stood. A silver page floats.
scene_beats.action: Declaration QTE: the light shatters Doubt.

rooms.description: Silver tome library, shelves breathing.
rooms.puzzle: Riddle of Light; wrong answers dim the room.

rooms.description: Arena tunnels lined with smudged portraits.
rooms.puzzle: Restore smudged portraits by standing in Beacon light.

boss.name: Doubt Made Flesh
boss.mechanic: Built from your Memory Ledger. Its hits shrink your Light; Declarations (QTE) restore it.

idle_animation.description: Shadow Arin shape flickers, smudges drip off it.

attacks.name: Your Own Swing
attacks.effect: Repeats your last attack at you

animation.description: Copy pose, wind up, swing, smirk

phases.transformation: Grows taller than the arena seats; abandoned pages orbit it.

attacks.name: Abandoned Pages
attacks.effect: Pages fly at you, shrink Light

phases.transformation: Becomes a towering wall of every failure, eyes everywhere.

attacks.name: Ledger Crush
attacks.effect: Two walls slam; Declare to survive

animation.description: Close, inhale, walls move, move, slam, open

defeat_animation.description: Light cracks it, cracks spread, it screams silent, shatters, mist, floor glows.

zeref_moment: Zeref's eye stars spin; he stands between Arin and Doubt.

title: Tree of Branches
location: Door of Hope and Unity, Tree of Infinite Branches

scene_beats.setting: Door carved with linked hands. Behind it, radiant chamber, the only bright frame in Act II.
scene_beats.action: The Door of Hope and Unity opens for the whole party at once.

dialogue.speaker: Sentinel Hesper
text_lines: It opens only if you are

scene_beats.setting: Colossal tree, branches reaching off screen into stars. Bark glows with vein lines.
scene_beats.action: Touch the bark: visions of battles and allies. Choose a path.

scene_beats.setting: Tree roots over a dry riverbed. Star shard in a knot of bark.
scene_beats.action: The Tree reveals the truth: the four rivers are stopping.

dungeon.name: Tree of Infinite Branches

rooms.description: Root tunnels with dry river channels.
rooms.puzzle: Pour water from the last puddle to wake root lanterns.

rooms.description: Branch vision room: three doorways of light.
rooms.puzzle: Pick Bright, Shadowed, or Winding; sets Act III.

dungeon.no_boss_note: Bible 2.13-2.16 has no fight here: the Tree reveals the truth. The Stilled Root (invented) is cut.

zeref_moment: Zeref tries to climb to infinity; gets one branch up, naps.
